UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Never use generic floating purple blobs, gradients over 20%, or childish illustration icons. Avoid buzzword copy like 'synergy', 'disruptive digital transformation', or 'cutting-edge AI ecosystem'. Use plain contractor English: 'More calls from your service area', 'A website that works on phones while you are on a ladder'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_priority: Mobile viewport is tier-1. Hard requirement: Sticky mobile bottom bar with high-contrast 'Call (888) 492-7489' and 'Get Free Quote' buttons. Minimum tap targets: 48px height, generous 16px touch padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rules: Strictly NO Inter for headings. Use Chivo, Cabinet Grotesk, or Barlow Condensed / Oswald for headings (heavy, sturdy, punchy construction feel) paired with IBM Plex Sans / DM Sans for ultra-readable body text. High contrast (APCA compliant), dark charcoal on warm off-white.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_nav: Sticky header with solid/glassmorphic backing (min 95% opacity or heavy blur backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/95 border-b border-stone-200). Never transparent over page images. Desktop must display key nav links: Services, Trades, Packages, Real Results, About, and primary CTA button 'Get a Free Quote'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, selectors, and metric cards MUST have explicit 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case.

faqs.q: Do I own my website or are you holding it hostage?
faqs.a: You own 100% of everything: the domain, the design, the text, and the customer data. If you ever leave us, we hand you full keys. No ransom fees.

faqs.q: I am not technical at all. How much work do I have to do?
faqs.a: About 25 minutes on a phone call. Send us photos of your work, your license/insurance info, and the towns you service. We handle all design, writing, coding, and launch.

faqs.q: How fast will my site be ready?
faqs.a: Starter and Heavyweight sites go live in 7 to 10 business days from the moment we finish our kickoff call.

When a customer calls and you are on a roof or under a sink and can't pick up, our system texts them back in 5 seconds: 'Hey, this is Dave with Apex Roofing. I'm on a jobsite right now. How can I help you?' This keeps them from calling your competitor.
